Jyhad Product Survey

Greetings!

Now that we've released Jyhad, we'd like to receive some feedback from our
players! Please answer each of the questions in the survey below and e-mail
it back to dorian@dominia.wizards.com. Or print it out and mail it to the
WotC address: PO Box 707, Renton WA, 98057.

Thanks!


1. On a scale of 1 to 5, how would you rate Jyhad?



2. What do you like most about Jyhad?



3. What do you like least about Jyhad?



4. Do you think Jyhad is:

___ Too slow of a game

___ Too fast of a game

___ Just right


5. What do you think of the vampires in the game?

___ They're excellent 

___ I like them

___ They're OK

___ I don't like them


6. What do you think of the art in Jyhad?

___ The art is excellent

___ I like the art

___ The art is OK

___ I don't like the art


7. What kind of strategy do you focus on when you construct your Jyhad deck?


___ Combat

___ Political

___ Sly manuevering using Disciplines

___ All of the above

___ Other: _________


8. Would you like to see Jyhad expansion sets?



9. If yes, what kinds of expansion sets would you like to see us release?


10. What kinds of cards would you like to see most in an expansion set? Grade
each catagory from 1 to 5.

___ Action cards

___ Political cards

___ Combat cards

___ Vampires

___ Master cards

___ Ally cards

___ Retainer cards


11. What is your favorite Jyhad library card? 



12. What is your favorite Jyhad vampire card?



13. Have you ever played Vampire: The Masquerade?



14. How many Jyhad decks and/or booster packs have you purchased? Will you
purchase more in the future?



15. What do you think about the box the game comes in?

___ It's excellent 

___ I like it

___ It's OK

___ I don't like it





Thank you for taking the time to answer this survey. Your answers are very
important to us! 


Additional note from the Cyberspace Liaison:  please send replies to
